summary: Iteration 9 (warehouse module + note sync/sospeso + histogram + date filter + role-based approval) fully tested. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter9.py — serial CRUD, bulk dedupe, RBAC (tecnico=403, magazzino=200, admin=200), sync flow marks CPE+ONT as scaricato with downloaded_by_name=tech, sospeso/espletato status persistence, admin approve+set-role with 'user'/'magazzino'/invalid=400, magazzino access to /api/notes. Frontend: admin login → page-switcher visible (nav-notes, nav-warehouse). Warehouse: add-serial-input + Enter creates, assign-<sn> select populated from /api/inventory/users, PATCH shows status=assegnato with assigned_to_name; delete-serial-<sn> removes row; bulk-serial-textarea (hidden inside <details>) + bulk-serial-btn creates multi. Notes: after PDF upload of /tmp/sample.pdf → 4 notes, stat-daily-avg=4.0 (emerald). status-toggle prompts window.prompt for reason, PATCHes {status:'sospeso',suspend_reason:'test motivo'}, SOSPESA badge appears, daily-avg drops to 3.0. Toggle back restores 4.0. monthly-histogram has exactly 30 bars; today's bar (hist-2026-09-11) carries ring-slate-900 outline and non-zero inner height (96px). date-from=2030-01-01 → empty-state; clear-date restores notes-groups. Sync flow: edit fields cpe/ont_sfp with test serials, save, click sync-note-<wr> → toast 'Sincronizzati 2 seriale/i', SYNC badge visible next to WR; verified via nav-warehouse: both serials present with status=SCARICATO and downloaded_by_name='Giuseppe Belviso' and timestamp. AdminPanel modal opens with pending section and role selectors present per code (approve-user-<email>, approve-magazzino-<email>, role-select-<email>). No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: The bulk-serial-textarea and bulk-serial-btn are inside a native <details> element (summary 'Inserimento massivo'). Playwright needed to click the summary first; consider adding data-testid to the summary (e.g. 'bulk-serial-details-toggle') for cleaner tests.

When a note is toggled to sospeso via status-toggle the card collapses (React remounts as the sorted list re-renders). A follow-up action (like sync) then requires re-expanding. Consider preserving open state by keying on note.id and lifting `open` state up, or auto-focus the same card after PATCH.

applyScan(value, target, snapshot) uploads the snapshot as a photo via POST /api/notes/{id}/photos (verified source at App.js:611-619). The actual video-frame capture inside ScannerModal cannot be triggered in Playwright without a real camera stream — verified only by source inspection per the request's guidance.
GET /api/inventory/users only returns role in ('user','admin') — magazzino users are excluded intentionally (they can't be assignees). This matches business rules; documenting for future testers.

server.py has grown to 782 lines and mixes auth, storage, PDF parsing, notes, and inventory in one module — consider splitting into routers (auth_router.py, notes_router.py, inventory_router.py) before it exceeds 1000 lines.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all documented flows passed; ScannerModal video-snapshot path source-verified only)
